description: U.S. electricity generation (TWh) 2005–2026 — Solar's meteoric climb vs. coal's collapse after the shale and policy revolutions.
youtube_description: A dramatic U.S. power-shift: solar went from near-zero to hundreds of terawatt-hours while coal — once the backbone of American electricity — cratered. This chart-race uses official generation trends (U.S. EIA historical data), SEIA/IEA capacity & policy milestones (shale gas boom, EPA rules, and the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act) to explain how economics, technology and policy flipped the grid. Watch the meteoric rise of solar, the shale gas pivot, and the slow-motion collapse of coal plants. Like, subscribe, and comment which year surprised you most — more data-driven visual stories every week. Sources: U.S. EIA, SEIA, IEA, U.S. EPA; methodology notes in the pinned comment. #solar #coal #energytransition #climate #grid
